hook.name: WobbHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the wobb.fun token launch platform. Intercepts swaps on registered tokens to collect platform and maker fees, apply anti-snipe and founder-sell surcharges, route dividends, and trigger auto buyback-and-burn of the launched token and/or the platform $WOBB token. Enforces a configurable staker-only early-access window and per-wallet buy cap during the guard window.
